doc.name: KillBounce Data
doc.instructions: Pay-per-call web, email, domain, security, code and image tools. Each call costs a fraction of a cent in USDC on Base via x402; a failed call (bad input, site blocked bots) is never charged. Image tools are free with free: "1" (lower limits). Pick the tool by job: email_verify before sending email; site_check to judge if a domain is legit; markdown for a page's main content; meta for declared facts (price, rating, dates); diff to watch a page; dns/certs/redirects for infrastructure; robots for crawler rules; rss for latest posts; github_tree before reading a repo; image_upload then image_edit for lossless edits (every edit re-renders from the original).

tools.name: email_verify
tools.title: Email verification
tools.description: Is this email address real and safe to send to? Returns status (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown, invalid), reason, and 0-100 score. Checks syntax, domain and MX records, asks the mail server whether the mailbox exists (no email is sent), detects catch-all domains, disposable/throwaway providers, role accounts (info@, support@), free providers, and suggests typo fixes (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: site_check
tools.title: Domain safety and setup audit
tools.description: One-call safety and setup audit for a domain: verdict (score + grade + summary) and a ranked list of issues, plus DNS, email security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS), SSL certificate (trust, issuer, expiry, days left, SANs, TLS version), domain age and registrar (RDAP), and HTTP redirect chain with security headers. Flags scam signals like newly registered domains and untrusted certificates. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

domain.description: Domain to audit (a full URL is accepted too)

tools.name: dns
tools.title: DNS and host lookup
tools.description: Multi-resolver DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA), IP addresses, network owner (ASN, network name, prefix, country), HTTP headers, and ping summary for a domain. One call replaces multiple lookups. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: markdown
tools.title: Web page to clean Markdown
tools.description: Any public URL as clean Markdown: main content only (no nav, ads, footers, scripts), with headings, links, lists, tables, and code kept. Handles articles, docs, and PDFs. Returns title, author, date, word count, and approx token count. Optional max_chars (default 20000, max 100000). Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL, or a PDF/plain-text URL

max_chars.description: Max Markdown characters to return (default 20000, max 100000)

tools.name: meta
tools.title: Page structured data and preview
tools.description: Structured facts a page declares about itself, without reading the page: highlights (product price, currency, stock, rating, brand; event dates, venue, address; article headline, author, date; organization, recipe, job posting), link preview (title, description, image), canonical URL, language, plus raw OpenGraph, Twitter card, JSON-LD (broken blocks repaired), and microdata. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of an HTML page

tools.name: diff
tools.title: Page change monitor
tools.description: What changed on a page. First call returns a snapshot_id; call again with since=<snapshot_id> to get only the added, removed, and changed lines (e.g. a price going from $29 to $39) instead of re-reading the page. Snapshots last 30 days. Or pass compare=<second url> to diff two pages directly. Works on HTML, PDFs, and text. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

since.description: snapshot_id from a previous call; returns changes since then

compare.description: Second URL to diff against url directly

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Web page plain text
tools.description: Fetches a public URL and returns clean main-text content, title, meta description, status code, and final URL after redirects. Strips nav, ads, scripts, and boilerplate. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: token
tools.title: Crypto token snapshot
tools.description: Normalized snapshot for any token by symbol or contract address: price, 24h change, market cap, volume, and rank. Saves agents scraping and rate limits. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: wallet
tools.title: Base wallet overview
tools.description: On-chain overview for any Base address: native balance and nonce. One call replaces multiple RPC queries. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: certs
tools.title: Certificate Transparency subdomain finder
tools.description: Every unexpired TLS certificate publicly logged for a domain (Certificate Transparency): all subdomains and wildcards found, issuing authorities with counts, certificates issued in the last 7 days, expiry dates, and flags such as sudden new issuance. Useful for mapping a domain's attack surface or spotting look-alike infrastructure. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: github_tree
tools.title: GitHub repository map for LLMs
tools.description: Compact map of a public GitHub repository for reading code with an LLM: filtered file tree (node_modules, build output and lock files removed), entry points, key config files, largest files with token estimates, total token estimate, languages, stars, license, last push, and the start of the README. Decide what to read before spending tokens. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit (default: the repo's default branch)

tools.name: robots
tools.title: AI crawler access checker (robots.txt)
tools.description: Whether a URL may be fetched by 20 named AI and search agents (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Googlebot, Bingbot, CCBot, and more), parsed to RFC 9309: the rules group that applied, crawl-delay, sitemaps, Content-Signal preferences, and whether llms.txt or ai.txt exist. Check before crawling, or audit a site's AI policy. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Page URL or domain to check

tools.name: rss
tools.title: RSS / Atom feed reader
tools.description: Latest items from a site's RSS, Atom, or JSON feed. Give a feed URL or any page: the feed is found automatically. Returns clean titles, links, ISO dates, authors, short plain-text summaries, and categories. Cheaper and more reliable than scraping a blog or news page for new posts. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Feed URL, or a website/blog page to discover the feed from

tools.name: redirects
tools.title: Redirect chain tracer
tools.description: Follows a URL hop by hop (up to 15) without loading the final page's content: status, Location, timing and server for each hop, final URL, and flags for loops, too many hops, HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades, cross-domain jumps, suspected open redirects, and meta-refresh redirects. Use on short links or tracking links before opening them. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: image_upload
tools.title: Image upload for lossless editing
tools.description: Upload an image once (url=, or POST the bytes) and get an image_id for /image-edit. Every edit is re-rendered from this original, so quality never drifts. Returns size, format, colors, metadata, GPS warning, and a clean copy link. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public URL of the image (or POST the image instead)

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

data_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (use instead of url for a local image)

tools.name: image_edit
tools.title: Non-destructive image editor
tools.description: Edit an uploaded image with a JSON list of ops, always re-rendered from the original (no quality loss), with numbered versions to undo or branch (from=0 = original). Resize, crop, social presets (instagram_square, story, og_image, youtube_thumbnail, favicon...), rotate, adjust colors, blur, captions, watermarks, logo overlay, rounded/circle. Output jpeg/png/webp/avif/gif/ico, max_kb size target. Metadata stripped. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

ops.description: JSON array of operations (an array, or the array as a JSON string)

from.description: Version to build on (default: latest; 0 = original). Use to undo or branch.

format.description: jpeg, png, webp, avif, gif, or ico

max_kb.description: Keep the output under this many KB

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

tools.name: image_info
tools.title: Image versions and fresh links
tools.description: For an uploaded image: original details plus every version (ops used, size, format) with fresh download links. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

tools.name: onchain
tools.title: Daily on-chain snapshot
tools.description: Daily cleaned on-chain activity snapshot for Ethereum and Base: latest block heights and simple activity proxies. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: domainrisk
tools.title: Daily risky email-domain feed
tools.description: Structured daily feed of domains showing catch-all, disposable, or elevated bounce-risk SMTP behavior, with risk level, confidence, and observation date. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: publicdata
tools.title: Daily top cryptocurrencies
tools.description: Cleaned daily extract of top cryptocurrencies by market cap: price, market cap, and 24h change in normalized JSON. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: sec
tools.title: SEC filings extract
tools.description: Clean extract of the latest SEC 10-K filing and recent 8-K count for any US stock ticker. Returns company name, CIK, filing date, accession number, and a direct link to the filing on EDGAR. Useful for agents that need public company data without scraping SEC pages. Price: $0.02 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: test
tools.title: Page and API tester
tools.description: Quick test of any public URL: HTTP status code, response time in milliseconds, SSL presence, content-type, and final URL after redirects. One call checks if a page or API endpoint is up and how it responds. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: kv
tools.title: Mutable key-value store
tools.description: Simple mutable key-value store for agents. POST {key, value} to save a short string (up to 10 KB). GET ?key= to read it back later. Useful for session state, intermediate results, or passing data between calls. Not for large files. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: email_send
tools.title: Send email
tools.description: Send an email from the service. POST {to, subject, body}. Requires SMTP configured on the server. Returns confirmation when sent. Useful for agents that need to notify a human or deliver a result by email. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: translate
tools.title: Translate text
tools.description: Translate text to a target language. GET ?text=hello&lang=es returns the translation. Supports common language codes. Uses a public translation service. Useful for agents working across languages without managing their own translation API. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: code
tools.title: Store code file
tools.description: Store a source code file and get a code_id. The original is kept unchanged. Later call /code/edit with a snippet and an anchor line to insert code and get a new version. Useful for agents that need to make small edits to large files without regenerating the whole file. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: code_edit
tools.title: Edit stored code
tools.description: Insert a snippet after an anchor line in a stored file. Returns the full new file and a version number. Original is unchanged. Price: $0.0025 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

anchor.description: Insert after the line containing this text

tools.name: file
tools.title: Store any file
tools.description: Store any file, private to the caller, 30-day expiry. Minimum $0.002. Above ~40 MB, $0.05 per GB. Declare size in the query (?bytes=) so the 402 quotes the exact amount. Returns an access_token for free later reads until expiry. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

bytes.description: Declared file size in bytes (used for pricing)
